proposition: Ibn Turka's Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid is a commentary that expands and refines his grandfather's Qawāʿid al-Tawḥīd, a treatise on absolute existence that tried to synthesize peripatetic and illuminationist philosophy with Ibn ʿArabian mystical theory; the Tamhīd became a staple teaching text and the main basis of Ibn Turka's modern reputation.
